title: Operation Bonehead
staging:
Scene 10 — Operation Bonehead

08:40–09:45 · 65 sec · Hideout workshop

Neon constructs electronic bone-shaped decoys that squeak, roll, and project irresistible animated chew toys. Ghost tests the distraction system while Byte questions its reliability.

Shots: Overhead workbench → rotating bone device → Neon testing remote → Ghost checking stealth equipment → comedy test.
